subject: McGlynn School Security Breach and Response
overview: The committee addressed a recent security breach at the McGlynn School involving an intruder and voted to cancel a student trip to Washington, D.C., due to security concerns following international events. Members also reviewed state standardized testing transitions and recognized several student achievements.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes from October 19, 2015, bills, and payrolls.

items.title: Special Education Parent Advisory Council Invitation
items.summary: Melanie McLaughlin invited the committee to a parent advisory meeting on December 9th and a basic rights workshop.

items.title: Cancellation of Washington, D.C. Trip
items.summary: Canceled a scheduled student trip to Washington, D.C., due to security concerns following recent international terrorist attacks. Superintendent Belson reported that insurance would likely cover at least 75% of the costs, and staff will look into virtual civic engagement alternatives.

items.title: MIAA Sportsmanship Award Recognition
items.summary: Recognized Jack Dempsey and students Gigi Braga, Victoria Rashi, and Katrina Rashi for winning first place in the MIAA multimedia sportsmanship competition.

items.title: Foreign Language Scholarship Award
items.summary: Announced that student Rachel Garland received a $1,000 Italian scholarship from the Federazione Associazione Abruzzese for academic excellence.

items.title: Approval of Puerto Rico Educational Trip
items.summary: Approved a student trip to Puerto Rico scheduled for April 2016, which includes a community service component.

items.title: Vocational School Report and Leadership Trip
items.summary: Reviewed a successful open house at the vocational school and approved an overnight SkillsUSA fall leadership conference.

items.title: Recognition of City Council Elections
items.summary: Congratulated committee members John Falco and George Scarpelli on their election to the Medford City Council.

items.title: Resolutions and Condolences
items.summary: Passed several resolutions of condolence for deceased community members, veterans, and staff families.

items.title: Veterans Day Program Report
items.summary: Received a report on the 15th annual Veterans Day program, where 21 veterans visited classrooms to discuss military service.

items.title: National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP) Results
items.summary: Reviewed 2015 data showing Massachusetts students continuing to lead the nation in reading and mathematics proficiency.

items.title: PARCC and MCAS Standardized Testing Update
items.summary: Referred the transition to 'MCAS 2.0' to a Committee of the Whole meeting pending final state guidance on the hybrid testing model.

items.title: McGlynn School Security Incident Report
items.summary: Referred school security protocols to a Committee of the Whole meeting following an October 30th incident where an intruder entered the McGlynn School and stole money. Superintendent Belson outlined a plan to enhance security, including a digital visitor ID system, while members criticized the delayed notification of the committee and the human errors that allowed the breach.

items.title: Old Business and Budget Requests
items.summary: Member DiBenedetto reiterated outstanding requests for Community Schools budget details and facilities rental income reports.
